comment: The contract cases of the validator (binding G-5): each case calls its member once with the arguments that it names by their parameter names, each json_value written as {kind, value}. A case without raises succeeds; raises names the kind of the failure. A case of an operation with a file loader gives the loader as a callback fixture: the rows of normalize and load, each with its arguments and its result or the error that it raises. The rules themselves are tested by the shared fixtures of tests/fixtures.
